page: Microsoft Azure E128ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor using the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes 7559 GB of local storage and is premium storage capable, though it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores placing in the top 10%. The Intel Xeon processor's L3 cache of 480 MB and support for advanced instruction sets, such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), contribute to top-tier results in CPU extended instructions and encryption tests. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with both small-block cached and large-block uncached read operations reaching top-tier performance. However, single-core performance in stress-ng and PassMark memory scores remain in the average tier.

Given its high memory density, substantial local storage, and top-tier database operations and Redis SET performance exceeding 209 million operations per second, this server is optimized for memory-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data warehousing, and multi-threaded data processing. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of 1024 GB RAM paired with 128 vCPUs and over 7.5 TB of local storage reduces the need for multi-node clustering for large datasets, though the lack of GPU acceleration limits its efficiency for active LLM text generation workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure E128ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family virtual machine configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of RAM, delivering a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 64 physical cores, a 480 MB L3 cache, and advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX, this x86_64 server achieves top-tier multi-core and memory bandwidth performance. It includes 7559 GB of local storage and supports premium storage, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor without GPU acceleration. Benchmarks show exceptional multi-threaded decompression, encryption, and database operations, alongside top-tier Redis SET performance. This server is highly suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and heavy multi-threaded data processing workloads where high local storage capacity and memory density are critical.
